```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(DBI)
library(dbplyr)
library(duckdb)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggtext)
library(showtext)

conn <- DBI::dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb(),
                       dbdir = "../threatened_sa.duckdb")

DBI::dbListTables(conn)
```

```{r}
protected_areas_db <- tbl(conn, " protected_areas")
protected_areas_db
```

```{sql connection=conn}

  SELECT c.country_name, COUNT(*) as total_occurrences FROM occurrences o
    JOIN protection_status ps ON o.species_id = ps.species_id
    JOIN countries c ON o.country_code = c.country_code
    WHERE ps.in_protected_area = TRUE
    GROUP BY o.country_code, c.country_name
    ORDER BY total_occurrences DESC;

```

```{r}
# Step 1: Extract the dataframes used for this join
occurrences_db <- tbl(conn, "occurrences")
protected_areas_db <- tbl(conn, "protected_areas")
countries_db <- tbl(conn, "countries")
protection_status_db <- tbl(conn, "protection_status")

pa_ranked_db <- occurrences_db %>%
  inner_join(protection_status_db, by = "species_id") %>%
  inner_join(countries_db, by = "country_code") %>%
  filter(in_protected_area == TRUE) %>%
  group_by(country_code, country_name) %>%
  summarise(total_occurrences = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(total_occurrences)) %>%
  collect()

# View the dataframe 
View(pa_ranked_db)

```

```{r}
# update font
# increase spacing 
# change grid line colors
# highlight Chile with one color 
# change other countries to be lighter color of that color
# title

font_add_google("Abyssinica SIL", "abyssinica")
showtext_auto()

# Colors 
iucn_red <- "#da2a1c"   
background <- "#222222"


pa_ranked_db %>% 
  mutate(highlight = ifelse(country_name == "Chile", "Chile", "Other")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(country_name, total_occurrences), 
             y = total_occurrences, fill = highlight)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Total Species Occurrences",
       title = "Where Are Endangered Species Being Protected in South America?",
       subtitle = "Chile leads with the most species occurrences found within protected areas.",
       caption = "Data Sources: World Database on Protected Areas (WDPA)\nGlobal Biodiversity Information Facility (GBIF)\nInternational Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN)") + 
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Chile" = iucn_red, "Other" = "white")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) + 
  theme(text = element_text(family = "abyssinica"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(color = "white", family = "abyssinica", size = 12, margin = margin(t = 10)),
         axis.text.y = element_text(color = "white", family = "abyssinica", size = 12), 
         axis.text.x = element_text(color = "white", family = "abyssinica", size = 12), 
        legend.position = "none", 
        plot.title = element_text(color = "white", family = "abyssinica",size = 15, margin = margin(t = 15)),
        plot.subtitle =  element_text(color = "white", family = "abyssinica", margin = margin(t = 10)),
        plot.caption = element_text(color = "white", family = "abyssinica", margin = margin(t = 13)),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "black", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "black", color = NA),
    panel.grid = element_blank())

pa_ranked_db %>% 
  mutate(highlight = ifelse(country_name == "Chile", "Chile", "Other")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(country_name, total_occurrences), 
             y = total_occurrences,
             fill = highlight)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(data = . %>% filter(country_name == "Chile"),
            aes(label = scales::comma(total_occurrences)),
            hjust = 1.1, color = "white", family = "abyssinica", size = 4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Chile" = iucn_red, "Other" = "grey60")) +  
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma, 
                     breaks = seq(0, 1500000, by = 500000)) +  
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Total Species Occurrences",
       title = "Where Are Endangered Species\nBeing Protected in South America?",  #
       caption = "Data Sources: World Database on Protected Areas (WDPA)\nGlobal Biodiversity Information Facility (GBIF)\nInternational Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN)") +
  theme_minimal() +
   theme(text = element_text(family = "abyssinica"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(color = "white", family = "abyssinica", size = 12, margin = margin(t = 10)),
         axis.text.y = element_text(color = "white", family = "abyssinica", size = 12), 
         axis.text.x = element_text(color = "white", family = "abyssinica", size = 12), 
        legend.position = "none", 
         panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(color = "white", family = "abyssinica",size = 15, margin = margin(t = 15)),
        plot.subtitle =  element_text(color = "white", family = "abyssinica", margin = margin(t = 10)),
        plot.caption = element_text(color = "white", family = "abyssinica", margin = margin(t = 13)),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = background, color = background),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = background, color = background),
    )
```

```{r}

library(rnaturalearth)
library(ggplot2)

# Get SA country geometries
sa_map <- ne_countries(continent = "South America", returnclass = "sf")

# Join with your query results
map_data <- sa_map %>%
  left_join(pa_ranked_db, by = c("iso_a2" = "country_code"))

# Plot
ggplot(map_data) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = total_occurrences)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma", na.value = "grey90") +
  labs(title = "Species Occurrences in Protected Areas",
       fill = "Total Occurrences") +
  theme_minimal()


ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = map_data %>% filter(iso_a2 != "CL"), 
          aes(fill = total_occurrences), color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_sf(data = map_data %>% filter(iso_a2 == "CL"), 
          fill = "#da2a1c", color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "grey90", high = "grey30", na.value = "grey90") +
  labs(title = "Where Are Endangered Species Being Protected?",
       fill = "Total Occurrences") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(text = element_text(family = "abyssinica"),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = background, color = NA),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        legend.title = element_text(family = "abyssinica", color = "white"),
        legend.text = element_text(family = "abyssinica", color = "white"),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = background, color = NA))

```
